_what: The signing rules services use, as verify rows (the format signed-service-calls.mjs reads). A waiter row names one in its mechanism_settings as "verify": "<rule name>", or gives its own verify object. A rule here is DATA: a new service is a new entry, never an edit to the mechanism. Each rule was checked against the vectors its service publishes (tests/signed-service-calls.test.mjs). The secret is never in a rule: the waiter names it by its vault name (credential_name). sign-in-tool-call is the Workshop sign-in tool's own signed call (tools/better-auth-official before-delete-url.mjs postSigned, used by its after-sign-up call and its before-delete clean-up): x-sign-in-timestamp holds whole seconds, x-sign-in-signature holds sha256= and the lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 of <timestamp>.<body>.
